segments.script: [EN: Quick review. Say I need —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Tôi cần.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say medicine —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: thuốc] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say pharmacy —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: nhà thuốc] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say fifteen —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: mười lăm] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say twenty-one —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: hai mươi mốt] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say four, at the end of a number —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: tư] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Listen.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: Phòng này rất đẹp!] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI: Dạ. Phòng hơi nhỏ.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: Còn phòng đó khá mới.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI: Dạ, khá đẹp.] [PAUSE 1s] [EN: Today, a structure: three small words that come BEFORE an adjective to say how much of it there is — a scale, from a little to a lot.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: First, the low end.] [VI: hơi] [EN: means a little, or somewhat. It has] [EN: a flat tone, no mark] [EN: — flat, no mark. Listen again.] [VI_F: hơi] [PAUSE 1s] [VI_F: hơi] [EN: Now you say it.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: hơi] [EN: Good. A little small —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: hơi nhỏ] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Next, the middle.] [VI: khá] [EN: means fairly, or rather. It has] [EN: a high, rising tone] [EN: . Listen again.] [VI_F: khá] [PAUSE 1s] [VI_F: khá] [EN: Now you say it.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: khá] [EN: Good. Fairly new —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: khá mới] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Last, the high end.] [VI: rất] [EN: means very. It also has] [EN: a high, rising tone] [EN: . Listen again.] [VI_F: rất] [PAUSE 1s] [VI_F: rất] [EN: Now you say it.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: rất] [EN: Good. Very beautiful —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: rất đẹp]
[EN: Quick pass over today's words.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: A little —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: hơi] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Fairly —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: khá] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Very —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: rất] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Let's drill. A little —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: hơi] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Fairly —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: khá] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Very —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: rất] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Now build it. Remember, the degree word comes before the adjective. A little old —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Hơi cũ.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Fairly small —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Khá nhỏ.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Very new —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Rất mới.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Swap in a word you already know. Very big —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Rất lớn.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Fairly cheap —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Khá rẻ.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Now reverse. I say the Vietnamese, you say the English.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: hơi] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: a little] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: khá] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: fairly] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: rất] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: very] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: One last time, before we move on.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: hơi] [PAUSE 1s] [VI_F: khá] [PAUSE 1s] [VI_F: rất] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Remember,] [VI: khá] [EN: and] [VI: rất] [EN: both have] [EN: a high, rising tone] [EN: , and] [VI: hơi] [EN: is] [EN: a flat tone, no mark] [EN: — flat.]

[EN: Listen again — now you understand it.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: Phòng này rất đẹp!] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI: Dạ. Phòng hơi nhỏ.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: Còn phòng đó khá mới.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI: Dạ, khá đẹp.] [PAUSE 1s] [EN: Your turn. Say it's very beautiful.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Rất đẹp.] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Next lesson, colors. One word to start —] [VI: màu] [EN: it means color. See you then.]
